_comment: Single source of truth for every number the public site asserts. Pages carry data-fact="<key>" spans; scripts/site_facts.py verifies each one against this file and CI fails on drift. Add a fact here before quoting it on a page. Numbers that belong to one measured run carry that run's snapshot id, because a fact without a snapshot cannot be re-checked.

registry-v2-10m-3sys.note: PostgreSQL's 10M column is a July measurement carried forward, marked in the table.

scale-sweep-collegemsg-94.note: Temperature 0, ONE SEED per cell, no confidence interval - unlike the primary campaign, which pools three seeds and reports paired bootstrap CIs. 7B/14B/32B are fp16; the 72B row is AWQ 4-bit, so it varies precision as well as size and is not a controlled scale point. Accuracy cells are 94ths (one task = 1.1 points); probe cells are 13ths (one probe = 7.7 points).

rag-breadth-h100.note: Secondary experiment: retrieval breadth at full 32k context on an H100, single seed. Not a model-scale point.

primary-campaign-collegemsg.note: Three seeds pooled, paired bootstrap CIs over 10k resamples. Source of the baseline correction-probe numbers.

retention-1m-density.note: Host xzgpu. Latency is a median of 30 reps (10 above 1 s); storage, memory and replay are single observations. The close-cache rerun is commit 96ea135.

retention-10m-resources.note: Memory caps enforced with docker --memory. Thread recalibration at 88b18d3, original sweep at 6fb7cb1. Memory-cap cells are warmup 2, reps 5; cold-start is a median of firsts over 5 trials.

registry_queries.prose: registry queries, each answered by every system and hash-verified before timing

system_count.prose: systems answering the same registry: TGMS native, TGMS-on-DuckDB, PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Neo4j, Memgraph

coverage_current.prose: of 110 independently written questions expressible in the current operator set

coverage_original.prose: of 110 expressible in the pre-registered 13-operator study (D-026, July 2026)

storage_bytes_per_row.prose: bytes per edge version, segments after compaction and generation collection, at 1M rows

storage_whole_store_bytes_per_row.prose: bytes per edge version for the whole store after generation collection

memory_10m_suite.prose: GB peak RSS for the full 10M query suite under a 2 GB cap

traversal_200k_graph_engines.prose: seconds for the same reachability query on Memgraph and Neo4j

clickhouse_agg_lead_10m.prose: times faster than TGMS on whole-window aggregation at 10M (40.0 vs 183.7 ms)
clickhouse_agg_lead_10m.history: 12x, then 8.7x after the D-044 refresh, then 4.6x after the D-046 scan work

agg_native_lead_200k.prose: times faster than ClickHouse on grouped aggregation at 200k (14.5 vs 32.6 ms)

reproducibility_band.prose: percent - single latency cells reproduce to about this band between days on the measurement host

unsupported_claims.prose: unsupported claims among the 268 evaluated answers of the dev-split campaign
unsupported_claims.scope_required: must be stated with its denominator, never as a universal guarantee

answer_accuracy_tgms.prose: percent of tasks whose structured answer exactly matched the reference (pooled, Qwen2.5-14B)

scale_tasks.prose: tasks in the frozen CollegeMsg test split (48 one-hop, 20 three-hop, 13 correction probes, 13 four-hop)

scale_probe_tasks.prose: correction probes inside the 94-task split; one probe is 7.7 percentage points

scale_acc_7b.prose: percent answer accuracy, Qwen2.5-7B fp16 (13 of 94, single seed)

scale_acc_14b.prose: percent answer accuracy, Qwen2.5-14B fp16 (32 of 94, single seed)

scale_acc_32b.prose: percent answer accuracy, Qwen2.5-32B fp16 (59 of 94, single seed)

scale_acc_72b_awq.prose: percent answer accuracy, Qwen2.5-72B AWQ 4-bit (48 of 94, single seed) - different precision, not a controlled scale point
scale_acc_72b_awq.scope_required: must never be drawn on one continuous line with the fp16 points

scale_gain_7b_32b.prose: times higher answer accuracy at 32B than at 7B, both fp16 (62.8 over 13.8; 59 of 94 over 13 of 94)

scale_probe_7b.prose: percent of the 13 correction probes answered exactly, 7B fp16 (5 of 13)

scale_probe_14b.prose: percent of the 13 correction probes answered exactly, 14B fp16 (10 of 13)

scale_probe_32b.prose: percent of the 13 correction probes answered exactly, 32B fp16 (13 of 13, single seed)
scale_probe_32b.scope_required: must be stated with its denominator of 13 and its single seed

scale_probe_72b_awq.prose: percent of the 13 correction probes answered exactly, 72B AWQ 4-bit (4 of 13)

scale_cypher_7b.prose: percent answer accuracy, text-to-Cypher baseline at 7B fp16

scale_cypher_32b.prose: percent answer accuracy, text-to-Cypher baseline at 32B fp16 - the best any evaluated baseline reached at any size

baseline_probe_best.prose: percent of correction probes answered exactly by the best evaluated baseline (vector-RAG); static-graph RAG and text-to-Cypher scored 0

rag_k1_acc.prose: percent answer accuracy, vector-RAG at k=1 over 256-event chunks on a 24 GB card

rag_k20_acc.prose: percent answer accuracy, vector-RAG at k=20 over 24-event chunks at full 32k context (2 of 94)

rag_k20_tokens.prose: prompt tokens per task, vector-RAG at k=20

rag_k20_exposure.prose: percent of the 59,835-event CollegeMsg corpus visible to the k=20 configuration in total (20 chunks x 24 events = 480 events)
rag_k20_exposure.was: published as '0.8% x 20 sites', which read as 16% and overstated exposure twentyfold

tgms_same_run_tokens.prose: prompt tokens per task, TGMS on the same run and model as the k=20 comparison

tgms_same_run_acc.prose: percent answer accuracy, TGMS on the same run and model as the k=20 comparison (34 of 94)

indep_blocked.prose: of 110 questions blocked by a capability that did not exist in the original 13-operator set

indep_g_blocked.prose: questions whose blockers include grouped or distinct aggregation, somewhere in the chain

indep_g_alone.prose: questions for which grouped aggregation was the only recorded blocker

indep_delivered.prose: questions that actually became expressible once grouped aggregation shipped, against 30 predicted

indep_still_blocked.prose: of the 30 predicted questions that stayed blocked, on a capability the tag concealed

indep_multi_blocker.prose: of the 98 blocked questions that need two or more missing capabilities at once

indep_scoreable.prose: of the 10 originally expressible questions whose answer kind was scoreable enough to run verbatim

zero_density_latency_spread.prose: percent - the widest latency gap between the full bi-temporal store and a current-only store at zero corrections, sign varying by query, against a 20 percent day-to-day reproducibility band

storage_overhead_1pct.prose: percent storage overhead over a current-only store at 1 percent correction density, 1M events

storage_overhead_5pct.prose: percent storage overhead at 5 percent correction density, 1M events

storage_overhead_20pct.prose: percent storage overhead at 20 percent correction density, 1M events

density_10m_interval_join.prose: times slower on the interval-join query at 10M events with only 0.1 percent correction density (1,102.6 vs 272.7 ms)

memory_10m_before.prose: GB peak RSS for the 10M suite before the statistics warm-up fix, whatever the query; OOM-killed under a 4 GB cap

memory_10m_smallbudget.prose: GB peak RSS for the 10M suite with a 256 MiB segment-cache budget

memory_cache_measured.prose: MB the segment cache actually held - far too little to explain a 5.93 GB peak, which is what refuted the cache diagnosis

evictions_smallbudget.prose: cache evictions under the 256 MiB budget, with every answer still hash-identical

threads_10m_speedup.prose: times faster on the interval-join query at 10M events going from 1 to 16 and 32 threads; at 1M the same sweep is flat within 1.4 percent

readers_1m_throughput.prose: times aggregate query throughput at 16 concurrent readers versus 1, at 1M events (173.1 vs 13.21 queries per second)

readers_10m_throughput.prose: times aggregate query throughput at 16 concurrent readers at 10M events, with 2 of the 16 readers OOM-killed

readers_latency_worst.prose: percent worse per-query latency for the slowest query at 16 readers (snap.hop2, 100.7 to 154.1 ms) - throughput scaling is not latency parity

coldstart_10m.prose: seconds to first answer at 10M events on a fresh process, whichever query runs first (median of firsts, 5 trials)

replay_20pct_before_min.prose: minutes to replay the event log at 20 percent correction density before the close-cache fix (2,856.8 s)

replay_20pct_after_min.prose: minutes to replay the same log after the per-generation close cache (361.1 s), a 7.9x reduction
